title: Predictions for Round 2
openingLines: Round 2 and a few teams could already move very close to qualification.
Now let us go game by game with the scorelines I would call.
disclaimer: Predictions are for entertainment purposes only.

matches.voiceover:
Spain dropped points in a 0 to 0 draw against Cape Verde, so they need an immediate response.
Saudi Arabia drew 1 to 1 with Uruguay and showed they can compete, but they should struggle against a more technical side.
Spain needs the win to take control of the group, so I expect them to dominate, but not by a huge scoreline.
My prediction is 2-0 Spain.

Belgium drew 1 to 1 with Egypt and cannot afford to drop more points here.
Iran comes from a 2 to 2 draw against New Zealand, showing attacking strength but also defensive problems.
This should be a dangerous game, but Belgium still has more quality to decide it in key moments.
My prediction is 2-1 Belgium.

Uruguay drew 1 to 1 with Saudi Arabia and now needs to recover the points lost in the opening round.
Cape Verde held Spain to a 0 to 0 draw, so this is not a match to underestimate.
Even so, Uruguay has more physical strength, more experience, and more match-winning quality.
My prediction is 2-0 Uruguay.

New Zealand drew 2 to 2 with Iran and showed they can be competitive in this group.
Egypt also drew in the opening round, holding Belgium to a 1 to 1 result, which was a very strong performance.
Because of the level of the opponent they faced and the need to win, I see Egypt as a slight favorite.
My prediction is 2-1 Egypt.

Argentina started very strongly, beating Algeria 3 to 0 and confirming their status as one of the favorites.
Austria also had a good start, beating Jordan 3 to 1, so this becomes a direct fight for the top of the group.
Austria arrives with confidence, but Argentina has more quality and experience to win a tight match.
My prediction is 2-1 Argentina.

France beat Senegal 3 to 1 in the opening round and already showed strength against a difficult opponent.
Iraq lost 4 to 1 to Norway and comes into this match under pressure after struggling a lot defensively.
Because of the technical gap and what both teams showed in the first round, France should control this game comfortably.
My prediction is 3-0 France.

Norway started very well, beating Iraq 4 to 1 and showing major attacking power.
Senegal lost 3 to 1 to France, but they faced one of the strongest teams in the tournament.
This looks like an open game, with Norway full of confidence and Senegal needing a reaction.
My prediction is 2-2 draw.

Jordan lost 3 to 1 to Austria and already comes into this match under pressure to stay alive.
Algeria also lost in the opening round, but they faced Argentina, one of the favorites to win the World Cup.
Based on individual quality and the context from the first round, Algeria looks better prepared to bounce back.
My prediction is 2-1 Algeria.

Portugal drew 1 to 1 with Congo and needs to show a better response in this second match.
Uzbekistan lost 3 to 1 to Colombia and also comes in needing points.
Portugal still has the stronger squad, more control, and more options to decide the game.
My prediction is 2-0 Portugal.

England had a very strong opening match, beating Croatia 4 to 2.
Ghana also started with a win, but it was a more controlled 1 to 0 result against Panama.
England comes in with more attacking power, but Ghana has already shown they can compete and make the game difficult.
My prediction is 2-1 England.

Panama lost 1 to 0 to Ghana and now needs points against a stronger opponent.
Croatia lost 4 to 2 to England, but still showed they can compete and score goals.
Because of their experience and need to react, Croatia should control this match better.
My prediction is 2-0 Croatia.

Colombia started very well, beating Uzbekistan 3 to 1 and taking control of the group.
Congo drew 1 to 1 with Portugal, a result that showed real competitiveness.
Even with Congo coming from a big draw, Colombia looks stronger to win another tight match.
My prediction is 2-1 Colombia.
